name: Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
original_name: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
source:
Petelgeuse is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing Sloth. He was once a respectable man, but was driven insane long ago.

Petelgeuse is the general depiction of insanity, preferring to talk while in weird positions, such as tilting his head or bending his waist, and also liked to engage in self harming activities, such as crushing his own fingers, pulling his hair out, smashing his head onto nearby walls of the cave he was situated in, etc. Despite him being the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he adheres to principles of living consisting of diligence and love. His love for Satella is the largest among the Sin Archbishops. He diligently follows and carries out orders from his gospel, always acting first in various situations, causing his name to be known as the most active Sin Archbishop, who has been responsible for more than half of all the the Witch Cult's activities and attacks.

Petelgeuse wields the Authority of Sloth, which manifests a supernatural ability known as Unseen Hands, invisible ogre strength shadow tentacles that are also capable of phasing through objects. He's usually accompanied by a particularly special group of 10 hand picked cultists called "Fingers" who act as sub-commanders and spare bodies for Petelgeuse, each leading one unit of several cultists.

[From [url=https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Petelgeuse_Romanee-Conti]Re:Zero Wiki[/url] and Wikipedia]
